data.name: List Tables
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists table records available through the IntegrationOS unified tables resource, enabling an agent to inspect tabular data.
Use for: retrieve tables, inspect table records, enumerate tabular resources
Not supported: creating tables, updating records, deleting records

data.name: Gets a list of Database Management private endpoints.
data.description: Gets a list of Database Management private endpoints.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists Database Management private endpoints in an OCI compartment, with optional name, VCN, state, and pagination filters.
Use for: find private endpoints, filter by compartment, inspect endpoint states
Not supported: creating endpoints, modifying endpoints, deleting endpoints

data.name: list database tables
data.description: Lists all the tables that are in the database related to the database_id parameter if the user has access to the database's workspace. A table is exactly as the name suggests. It can hold multiple fields, each having their own type and multiple rows. They can be added via the createdatabasetablefield and createdatabasetablerow endpoints.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists all tables in a specified Baserow database when the caller has access to its workspace. Use the results to discover tables before accessing their fields or rows.
Use for: enumerate database tables, discover table IDs, inspect database structure
Not supported: creating tables, listing rows, managing fields

data.name: Gets a list of tablespaces for a Managed Database.
data.description: Gets the list of tablespaces for the specified managedDatabaseId.

data.name: List Tables
data.description: List tables in the given table bucket. For more information, see S3 Tables in the Amazon Simple Storage Service User Guide.  Permissions  You must have the s3tables:ListTables permission to use this operation.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists tables in an Amazon S3 table bucket, optionally filtered by namespace or prefix and paged with a continuation token.
Use for: enumerate S3 tables, filter by prefix, page through table results
Not supported: creating tables, reading table data, deleting tables

data.name: Gets the list of databases using a specific Database Management private endpoint.
data.description: Gets the list of databases using a specific Database Management private endpoint.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists databases associated with a specified OCI Database Management private endpoint, with compartment and pagination controls.
Use for: find associated databases, inspect endpoint relationships, page through databases
Not supported: registering databases, changing associations, deleting databases

data.name: Lists Managed Databases.
data.description:
Gets the Managed Database for a specific ID or the list of Managed Databases in a specific compartment.
Managed Databases can be filtered based on the name parameter. Only one of the parameters, ID or name
should be provided. If neither of these parameters is provided, all the Managed Databases in the compartment
are listed. Managed Databases can also be filtered based on the deployment type and management option.
If the deployment type is not specified or if it is ONPREMISE, then the management option is
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists OCI Managed Databases in a compartment or returns one by ID, with filters for name, deployment type, and management option.
Use for: find managed databases, filter by deployment type, inspect database inventory
Not supported: creating databases, changing configuration, deleting databases

data.name: Lists database parameters.
data.description: Gets the list of database parameters for the specified Managed Database. The parameters are listed in alphabetical order, along with their current values.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists current parameters and values for a specified OCI Managed Database, optionally filtering by parameter name.
Use for: inspect database parameters, check current values, find allowed values
Not supported: changing parameters, restarting databases, creating parameters

data.name: Lists the external databases.
data.description: Lists the external databases in the specified compartment or in the specified DB system.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists external databases in an OCI compartment or DB system, with optional display-name filtering and pagination.
Use for: find external databases, filter by display name, inspect external database inventory
Not supported: registering databases, changing database settings, deleting databases

data.name: Lists Managed Database Groups.
data.description:
Gets the Managed Database Group for a specific ID or the list of Managed Database Groups in
a specific compartment. Managed Database Groups can also be filtered based on the name parameter.
Only one of the parameters, ID or name should be provided. If none of these parameters is provided,
all the Managed Database Groups in the compartment are listed.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists OCI Managed Database Groups in a compartment or returns one by ID, with optional name and lifecycle-state filters.
Use for: find database groups, filter by lifecycle state, inspect group inventory
Not supported: creating groups, adding databases, deleting groups
